title: Identifying Reliable Evaluation Metrics for Scientific Text Revision

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the pairwise preferences of each LLM acting as a judge to determine if the models disproportionately favor their own generated text revisions over those produced by other models.

Correlating evaluation metric scores and LLM judge preferences with the Levenshtein edit distance between the original and generated texts to measure whether evaluation methods unfairly penalize substantial revisions or favor minimal edits.
